rounds.title: Validated navigation
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Model progression so invalid steps cannot be skipped.
constraints: Start on Basic info and expose the current step title.
Validate the fields owned by the current step before advancing.
Advance through Address to a read-only Summary without losing earlier values.

frameworkTests.name: Round 1 · Valid data advances to Address

rounds.title: State-preserving backtracking
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Let candidates revise earlier steps without resetting valid work.
constraints: Back returns to the previous step and preserves every entered field.
Revalidation happens against the latest edited values.
The Summary is derived from form state rather than a copied snapshot.
Submission is available only from a valid Summary.

rounds.title: Accessible step state
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Make validation and progress understandable without relying on layout alone.
constraints: Expose a stable progress element with the one-based current step and total step count.
Associate field errors with their controls and move focus to the first invalid field.
Announce step changes through a polite live region.
Prevent double submission while the final action is pending.

frameworkTests.name: Round 3 · Progress and validation are announced
